So nobody short-changes you, and you know who really won the race!

🔑 Decimal facts

⏺️ The point

The point splits whole numbers from ?

PARTS of one

1️⃣ Tenths

First place after the point is ?

TENTHS (0.1)

2️⃣ Hundredths

Second place after the point is ?

HUNDREDTHS (0.01)

💷 Money

Money needs ?

2 places: £4.50

After the point: tenths, then hundredths.
